items.title: 受OpenAI營收報告影響，英偉達、甲骨文、CoreWeave等人工智慧概念股下跌。

items.summaryEn: OpenAI has told investors that it hit roughly $50 billion in annualized revenue at the end of September, CNBC confirmed.
